hypothesis: The unchanged V18 transport-acceptance owner can remain the portfolio primary while trend-financed opening-auction rejection captures otherwise idle intervals. Because the two owners are temporally exclusive and V18 always preempts, the composition should add independently positive after-cost expectancy without weakening V18's PF, PnL/DD, month breadth, or concentration.

ownership.primary: replay no V18 signals: consume its immutable basis_breadth trade ledger exactly
ownership.addon: only the exact V43 trend-aligned, V18-flat event set; unchanged V42 branch-state exit at anchor cutoff or next add-on
ownership.priority: a V18 entry closes any add-on at that exact matched-MCL open before V18 begins
ownership.capital: one mutually exclusive MCL position; no overlapping contracts or additive sizing

execution.contract_or_clock_discontinuity: flatten add-on at last valid matched-MCL close
execution.v18_preemption: flatten add-on at exact V18 entry MCL open

validation_law.discovery: simulate add-on outcomes only before the split and compare the exact non-overlapping portfolio with unchanged V18
validation_law.if_discovery_fails: reject and leave every validation add-on outcome unopened
validation_law.if_discovery_passes: open the exact same add-on owner and priority law in validation; validation and full periods must independently pass the same gate

controls.unchanged_primary: report V18 alone beside every combined period
controls.addon_standalone: report independently; it is not separately selectable below 160/year
controls.same_addon_inverted: not selectable and not required because V42 already rejected opposed financing

prohibitions: no V18 entry, direction, exit, hold, cost, or outcome mutation
no concurrent MCL positions or increased contract count
no alternate add-on financing, branch, anchor, side, direction, month, volatility, or news gate
no validation add-on outcomes unless discovery passes every gate
no order, capital, XSP, or Gold authority
downstream_hold_even_on_pass: missing July 2023 through August 2024 dated-contract history
unseen runtime parity and prospective signal tape
native MCL spread, liquidity, margin, commission, roll, preview, restart, reconciliation, shared-capital, and graduation proof
